card.name: End of a study-group subject phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase naming a study group, treatment or patients, right before the main verb of a result sentence (e.g. 'the exercise group showed', 'those who had strength training fared').

modes.label: Study group as subject
modes.description: Group or arm names such as 'group' or 'training' that end the subject before a verb about outcomes.
modes.example: At the end of the study, the exercise<< group>> showed improvements in memory and language skills.

card.writes: It seems to prepare for a verb to follow the subject, with a mild push toward Chinese-style and odd tokens, so no clear output effect on English.
card.plain: It marks the end of the 'who' in a results sentence, just before we hear what happened to them.
